top_news.title: Do Vision CIL Methods Transfer to Protein? A Diagnostic Benchmark of Frozen Protein Encoders
top_news.dek: Researchers benchmarked nine class-incremental learning (CIL) methods on frozen protein encoders to evaluate their efficacy in protein function annotation.
top_news.brief: Protein function annotation requires adapting to new labels without full retraining. This study tests vision-derived CIL techniques across five protein encoder architectures (sequence, structure, and hybrid) to determine how well they handle expanding label spaces while keeping the underlying encoders frozen.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing protein encoder architecture and CIL workflow

top_news.title: Introducing UL Gauntlet, a Benchmark for How Well AI Explains
top_news.dek: The UL Gauntlet benchmark evaluates AI models on their ability to provide high-quality, singular explanations based on David Deutsch's criteria.
top_news.brief: The benchmark tests 30 model configurations by requiring them to explain complex concepts, commit to a single explanation, and justify their reasoning. It aims to move beyond standard accuracy metrics to measure the depth and logical consistency of AI-generated explanations.

top_news.title: Singer or clanker? YouTube Music will tell you with new gen AI labeling.
top_news.dek: YouTube Music is rolling out mandatory labeling for AI-generated content to improve transparency.
top_news.brief: YouTube has begun implementing labels for music tracks created or altered by generative AI. The feature is currently appearing in the YouTube Music app and is expected to expand to the main YouTube platform shortly, helping users distinguish between human-performed and AI-synthesized audio.
top_news.image_alt: YouTube Music interface showing an AI-generated content label on a track.

top_news.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
top_news.dek: Google DeepMind is leveraging its Antigravity system to expedite the discovery of new antimicrobial peptides.
top_news.brief: DeepMind is applying its latest AI research to the field of drug discovery, specifically targeting the identification of antimicrobial peptides. The initiative aims to accelerate the development of new treatments by utilizing advanced computational modeling to screen potential candidates more efficiently than traditional laboratory methods.
top_news.image_alt: Visualization of antimicrobial peptide structures generated by AI.

top_news.title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more autonomy without losing control
top_news.dek: AWS introduces 'Trust in Depth' to manage AI agent autonomy through a layered verification framework.
top_news.brief: AWS has outlined a 'Trust in Depth' strategy to help enterprises deploy autonomous agents safely. The framework uses five layers—scope, know, bound, observe, and prove—to constrain agent behavior and verify actions. This approach aims to balance agent flexibility with the need for predictable, auditable outcomes in production environments.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram illustrating the five layers of the AWS Trust in Depth framework.

primary.title: Google: How we're helping the world prepare for natural disasters
primary.summary: Today is International ShakeOut Day, when millions practice earthquake drills. Our Android Earthquake Alerts System turns smartphones into a global network that can warn people before shaking arrives, and it's expanding to more countries and regions.When a natural disaster strikes, early warnings and trusted information help people prepare, respond, and stay safe. Earthquakes are only one part of our crisis resilience efforts at Google. Our AI models also help people prepare for other natural disasters:Floods: Our flood forecasting technology provides up to seven days' notice for riverine floods for more than two billion people in 150 countries and up to 24 hours' notice for urban flash floods.Cyclones: WeatherNext can predict cyclones up to 15 days out.Wildfires: Near-real-time fire boundary maps are live in 34 countries, and FireSat, a global satellite constellation, is designed to detect and track fires as small as a classroom within 20 minutes once completed.In 2025 alone, Google helped connect people with crisis information more than 10 million times per day, on average.Our north star is simple yet ambitious: No one should be surprised by a natural disaster.Learn more about our progress on crisis resilience and how we are working with partners and communities around the world to better prepare for natural disasters in our new Crisis Resilience white paper.
